title: "Disappointing" is an understatement
text:
"Disappointing" is an understatement. This so-called "atomic" alarm clock is terrible. I bought it because of the front-facing buttons and had hoped the other critical reviews were mistaken. Nope - they were spot on.

CON:
1. Does NOT pick up the atomic time signal, even after 2:00 a.m. when most atomic clocks automatically receive it. I have other atomic clocks and they have all "sync'd" within 20 minutes of installing batteries. NOT THIS ONE.
2. Inside temperature measurement: off by 7 degrees after putting in batteries and has only gone down 1.4 degrees in 26 hours !!
3. Alarm: Very, very faint sound and my hearing is excellent. This wouldn't wake an ant.

PRO:
The buttons are on the front. NO other positives about this item.

I do not recommend this so-called "atomic" alarm clock at all.
